artifact_observations.reasoning: The red straps exhibit impossible geometry. They appear to fuse into the handles of the screwdrivers and the hammer head without clear attachment points. The loops on the right side seem to float or merge with the background/toolbox wall rather than anchoring logically. The material looks like melted plastic rather than elastic fabric.

There is significant boundary bleeding between the red straps and the black/red tool handles. The edges are soft and indistinct, suggesting the AI struggled to render two separate objects touching closely.

The metallic reflections on the hammer head are inconsistent and slightly 'smudged,' lacking the sharp specular highlights expected of polished metal. It has a slightly painted or rendered look rather than a photorealistic metallic texture.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a tool kit and not a generic container or abstract arrangement.
To rigorously audit the connectivity of the red straps. Do they form continuous loops? Do they attach firmly to the toolbox walls? This addresses the severe structural collapse observed.
To verify if the tools sit correctly within the depth of the compartments or if there is floating/bleeding into the background.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and texture quality of the materials (plastic vs. metal).

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the red retention straps (continuity and attachment points)
Boundary sharpness between tools and straps (fusion artifacts)
Realism of metallic textures on the hammer
Logical organization of tools within compartments
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red straps. In AI images, elastic bands often melt into the objects they constrain. Verify if the straps have logical start and end points. Also, check if the hammer head's geometry is physically valid (flat face, correct claw shape) or if it is distorted.
